commit.message:
fix: apply graph-contract review findings

- runtime: use performance.now() for monotonic telemetry durations (was Date.now()).
- guards: validate result.output is present in guardJudgmentValid (was only invocationId).
- fde-graph: add run.retry-ready / run.completed / run.aborted terminal nodes and point the retry/complete/abort edges at them.
- generators: annotate Mermaid edge labels with the phase-change so abort from-phases are visible.
- regenerate docs/graph/generated.md.
